title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & hygiene
author: Harper Lin
release_notes: Split CI workflows to reduce runtime cross-talk between lint/test/release jobs; improve caching for Node build matrices; remove deprecated actions and normalize action versions. No product-facing changes.
description: Motivation: Our consolidated CI workflows have grown complex and brittle as we added more repo types (sdk, docs, infra) and incremental release automation. This PR splits the pipelines into smaller, focused workflows (lint, test, release) and standardizes caching/inputs to improve cache hit rates and reduce wasted runner time. Changes: 1) Split workflows: - .github/workflows/lint.yml: runs ESLint/ruff/markdownlint on PRs and push for docs changes - .github/workflows/test.yml: Node/python test matrix, with granular job-level caches and explicit failure isolation - .github/workflows/release.yml: release automation is now separate, triggered only on release tags and the release branch with improved artifact verification 2) Cache & actions hygiene: - Normalize actions to pinned versions (use sha or major with documented rationale) - Rework Node build cache: use deterministic key including package-lock hash and matrix-variant; reduce cache restore scope to speed up misses - Remove legacy GH Action steps used for monorepo bootstrap that conflict with newer setup 3) Secrets & permissions: - Least-privilege tokens for release job, set workflows to permissions: read/write minimal scopes - Audit logging hooks added for release path 4) CI ergonomics: - Faster lint stage via staged eslint caching and parallelism - Test jobs now include optional flaky test rerun count on single failures - Split ESLint config path resolution to avoid running full monorepo dependency graph on SDK-only PRs Checklist: - [x] Split workflows created and tested on fork - [x] Reduced overall runtime on sample PRs by ~35% - [x] Verified release artifacts and signature step - [x] Updated CONTRIBUTING.md with new workflow triggers - [x] Rollout plan documented in ENG-8742 Backwards compatibility: No code-level breaking changes; repo contributors only see CI layout changes. Rollout: Gradual rollout over 48 hours with monitoring on runner queue length and cache hit-rate (dashboard updated).
commits: 3 commits: 1) split workflows and initial cache keys (Harper Lin) 2) pin actions and add test rerun logic (Harper Lin) 3) fix permissions and release gating (Harper Lin)
changed_files: Key files changed: .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml}, .github/actions/ (removed legacy bootstrap), .github/workflows/shared/cache-helpers.yml, package.json/package-lock.json update hints, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ci.md
review_threads:
Asha: 'Can we avoid restoring the full node_modules cache for every matrix cell?' -> Harper: 'Updated keys to include matrix.variant and limited scope to build artifacts; see test.yml job-level cache.'
Diego: 'Release job should not run on draft tags' -> Harper: 'Added if: startsWith(github.ref, "refs/tags/") && !contains(github.event.release.draft, true)'
Lina: 'Pinning actions by major is risky; prefer SHA for critical steps' -> Harper: 'Pinned critical steps (checkout, setup-node) to specific SHA; left some non-critical helpers on major to allow minor fixes, added comment.'
CI: initial run showed flaky lint job due to markdownlint plugin version mismatch -> Harper pushed fix (commit 3) to align versions. Final CI run: all checks pass.
ci_summary: Matrix: node 18/20 x ubuntu-latest, python 3.10/3.11; lint stage split, test stage parallelized. Initial run: 2 failures (lint plugin version, release permission) fixed in follow-up commit; final: all green.
notes_for_sre: Monitor runner queue and cache hit-rate dashboard for first 24h post-merge. Expect transient cache misses; if runner queue increases by >20% rollback plan in ENG-8742.
contributing_docs_update: Updated docs/ci.md and CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect new workflow triggers and local reproduction steps for lint/test.
